v.t: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

v.t: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

v.t: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

v.t: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

v.t: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

v.t: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
